title: Closed-loop AI achieves certifiable engineering design
abstract: arXiv:2608.21976v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic AI has automated parts of scientific discovery, including paper generation, expert-level coding, therapeutic proposal, and autonomous experimentation. Complex physical engineering design remains a gap, because candidates must satisfy simultaneous constraints in fluid dynamics, solid mechanics, and structural stability. We introduce The AI Engineer, an agentic framework that couples large language models (LLMs) to deterministic engineering backends in a closed loop: natural-language requirements are converted into design-domain geometry and mesh; topology is optimized with bi-directional evolutionary structural optimization (BESO) coupled to the CalculiX solver; and member sizes are refined with particle swarm optimization (PSO) coupled to Zwind under offshore aero-hydro-servo-elastic load cases. translated_title: 闭环人工智能实现可认证的工程设计
translated_abstract: 代理型人工智能已自动化了科学发现的某些部分，包括论文生成、专家级编码、治疗提案和自主实验。然而，复杂的物理工程设计仍存在差距，因为候选方案必须同时满足流体动力学、固体力学和结构稳定性方面的约束。我们引入了“AI工程师”，这是一种代理框架，将大型语言模型与确定性工程后端闭环耦合：自然语言需求被转换为设计域几何和网格；拓扑通过双向进化结构优化（BESO）与CalculiX求解器耦合进行优化；构件尺寸通过粒子群优化（PSO）与Zwind在海上气动-水动-伺服-弹性载荷工况下进行细化。为了在不产生逐个候选认证成本的情况下探索多种设计，一个自动评审器从五个维度（能力、效率、稳定性、安全性、可制造性）对每个候选方案进行评分，确保只有高潜力设计进入最终认证阶段。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种闭环代理框架“AI工程师”，将大语言模型与确定性工程求解器结合，实现可认证的复杂工程设计，并通过自动评审器在无需逐个认证成本的情况下探索和筛选设计。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "The AI Engineer," a closed-loop agentic framework coupling LLMs with deterministic engineering solvers to achieve certifiable complex engineering design, using an automated reviewer to screen candidates without per-design certification costs.
